title: validation_store's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: Every proof in cairn/tools/validation_store takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a validation_store proof makes outlives its run.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: bare_temp_reach over the repo named 2 validation_store line(s): cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_source_files_are_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-eol-pin-proof-")), landed under 88e30cde9bd4); cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_the_hook_source_checks_out_lf.py:64 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-hook-pin-proof-")), landed under daaf7ac3e4ec); so cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py::test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare reds. cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp.
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_source_files_are_lf_on_every_box.py:52 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-eol-pin-proof-")), landed under 88e30cde9bd4); cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_the_hook_source_checks_out_lf.py:64 (tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-hook-pin-proof-")), landed under daaf7ac3e4ec). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. New red-first proof cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_stores_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, the pattern of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py: one tooth test_no_proof_in_validation_store_reaches_temp_bare asserting bare_temp_reach(REPO / 'cairn/tools/validation_store') == [], the scan bound at call time. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.

clauses.claim: bare_temp_reach over cairn/tools/validation_store names no line, so no validation_store proof reaches the system temp directory except through scratch_dir

decisions.text: D1: each named site takes scratch_dir(prefix) in place of Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=...)).
D2: cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_stores_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py is new, one tooth, the tools/base door proof's pattern.

out: every other component's bare sites (each in its own ticket, RULE 1)
cairn/tools/scratch (the door and the scan are unchanged)
